headline: Delegate outcomes, not every next step.
lede: The product is not a smarter router. It is a structure for who may act, what context travels with the work, how work is claimed, and where responsibility stops.

items.label: Research
items.title: Roles exist individually and relationally
items.body: Each role is defined by its responsibility and by the people, work, and other roles around it.

items.label: Bounded authority
items.title: Authority is explicit
items.body: Each role knows what it may do, for whom, and under which conditions. Consequential actions stop for review.

items.label: Coordinated handoff
items.title: Work carries high-level context
items.body: A role can pick up a task with its purpose and priorities intact instead of waiting for the operator to narrate every next move.

items.label: Operator attention
items.title: Intervention is the exception
items.body: Safe work advances unattended. The operator sees the decisions only they can make, with enough context to decide.

status_note: The public reference runs today for one operator. Shared ownership and delegated approval across several people remain design direction, not a claim about the current checkout.
